name: portable-voice-production
changes: Added exact gpt-5.5 -> deepseek-v4-pro routing inside the bundled CC Switch local proxy while preserving every other model and provider
Allowed guarded SQLite transaction updates while CC Switch remains online so the active Codex conversation is not interrupted
Grouped dashboard tasks into five user-facing stages with precise next actions, source metadata, timestamps, and missing-deliverable detection
Expanded the v2.1 beginner manual with reading paths, terminology, six-Chat responsibilities, status tables, delivery checks, troubleshooting, FAQ, and reviewed references
Separated monitoring from pullback and gated all downloads on success plus failed equaling the full batch total
Updated the dashboard with terminal, success, failure, running, and downloaded counts plus partial-failure delivery
Added a mandatory six-Chat bootstrap gate that blocks production until every role has a unique thread ID and verified full access
Established synchronized installer and GitHub development workflows for v2.1
Made API add, remove, and active-selection actions persist immediately instead of remaining in UI memory
Fixed the API tool action bar so save controls remain visible at supported window sizes
Installed the API configuration EXE and workspace locator inside every project's 04_管理与记录/01_API配置 directory
Added full package, documentation, GUI, API-pool, CC Switch, workflow, and clean-release validation for the 2.0 baseline
Bundled the complete CC Switch 3.18.0 Windows program with guarded local deployment
Locked CC Switch model mapping to the single exact route 5.5 -> deepseek-v4-pro and reject changes to other models
Added a copy-ready Codex instruction and a detailed end-to-end user manual
Added automatic test/production Seedance API import, multi-provider organization, hidden API-pool state, and balance-failover coordination
Added a native Seedance API configuration program with project selection, masked key entry, deduplication, and desktop shortcut
Added the complete local Seedance API configuration workflow and endpoint rules
Added a guarded CC Switch database configurator for provider.meta.localProxyRequestOverrides.modelRoutes without touching Codex model catalogs
Added backup, dry-run, integrity verification, request verification, and rollback instructions
Kept credentials, live databases, production media, servers, and D:\codex-board outside the package

requirements.python: 3.10+ for installation, Codex scripts, and guarded CC Switch mapping; desktop tools bundle their runtimes as EXE
requirements.network: required only for actual Seedance API operations

excluded: live CC Switch database and provider data
